## Functions

### `createAmbientMaterialComposition(id, settings = {})`

Factor the actual paint program into persisted source contributions. A disconnected node substitutes its neutral expression, not a metadata toggle. The old generator remains byte-stable for source migration. Factory refinements belong to these saved contributions, so custom and historical sources survive.
